notes: I changed the model from "always 0" to an indicator function: f(x)=1 when |x|≤1 and 0 otherwise. This fits E2 exactly (all points with |x|≤1 gave 1, all with |x|>1 gave 0) and remains consistent with E1 (all |x|>1 → 0). The boundary at |x|=1 is a guess from the data (0.5 and 1.0 both give 1, 3.7 gives 0), marked as the natural break point.
